publicationStmt.p: Excerpt from Inscriptiones Graecae, Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities. CC BY 4.0. https://telota.bbaw.de/ig/digitale-edition/inschrift/IG%20I%C2%B3%20476 . Extracted 2026-10-25; original line markup and text retained; unrelated lines omitted.

sourceDesc.p: Ancient inscription, 408/7 BCE; modern critical edition. Brackets are editorial restorations, not all surviving letters.
